content:
BREAKING: Gerardo Navarro was arrested in Webb County on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, on a third-degree felony charge of unlawful possession of a firearm by a felon, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search.

Navarro, booking #202608905, was arrested at 4:08 p.m. The booking record also lists two misdemeanor charges: discharge of a firearm in certain municipalities, a Class A misdemeanor, and driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor.

No bond had been set at the time of booking. The record lists case numbers 2026CRO000893D1 and 24PD002033 in connection with the firearm charges, and 2026CRB000210L1 and 25PD001501 in connection with the DWI charge.

The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

An arrest is an accusation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources:

  • Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search
  • Webb County public-access court records

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, Webb Watch 956
